newsitem.title: INDIA: India wedding party accident kills at least 71.
newsitem.headline: India wedding party accident kills at least 71.

text.p: A truck carrying guests to a wedding party fell into a gorge in northern India killing at least 71 people, news agencies said on Friday.
Seventy people were killed on the spot and one died on the way to hospital, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said. The dead included many children, the agency said.
The accident happened on Thursday night.

PTI said rescuers had brought all the bodies to Hamirpur village in the mountainous state of Himachal Pradesh. Four of the critically injured had been sent to a hospital in the northern city of Chandigarh.
United News of India said eight of the passengers were injured, including five seriously. PTI said the truck was carrying 90 people.
PTI said authorities were trying to identify the bodies and were making arrangements for a mass cremation.
